We recommend upgrading to the latest Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome or Firefox. 311 GovMeetings Calendar Translate English Español Kreyòl Ayisyen Menu Login Search Mobile Search Search Desktop Search Login Home > Government > Departments > Fire Rescue > Safety Tips > Holiday & Seasonal Safety > Inclement Weather Share: Severe weather can strike quickly, bringing heavy rain, flooding and dangerous lightning. Miami-Dade Fire Rescue urges residents and visitors to stay informed, take precautions and prioritize safety during storms. Social Media Toolkit Driving on Wet Roads Avoid Walking or Driving in Flooded Areas Slow Down on Wet Roads Avoid Downed Power Lines Keep an Eye on Weather Forecasts See a Flash? Dash Inside! Turn Around, Don’t Drown! Store and Secure Loose Outdoor Items Don’t Drive or Charge EVs Exposed to Flood Waters Store Important Documents in Fire and Waterproof Containers Don’t Let Children or Pets Play in Flood Waters Don’t Drive Around Emergency Vehicles Only Use Generators Outside Only Call 911 for Emergencies Protect Your Family from the Dangers of Carbon Monoxide Never Refuel a Running Generator Be Safe When Using Ladders Fire Rescue Raied "Ray" Jadallah Fire Chief R.
